blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) and Asian Infrastructure and Holdings Corporation (AIHC) have broken ground on a new logistics facility for FedEx in Clark under their joint venture, RL Clark Logistix, Inc. (RCLX).

The groundbreaking ceremony was held on May 19, 2026 at Clark International Airport, attended by Department of Finance Secretary Frederick Go; Department of Trade and Industry Secretary Cristina Roque; Bureau of Customs Port of Clark District Collector Jairus Reyes; Bases Conversion and Development Authority President and CEO Joshua Bingcang; Clark Development Corporation President and CEO Agnes Devanadera; Luzon International Premiere Airport Development Corp. President and CEO Noel Manankil; LIPAD Director Jefferson Cheng; FedEx North and South Pacific President Masamichi Ujiie; FedEx Philippines Managing Director Maribeth Espinosa; Robinsons Land Corporation President and CEO Mybelle Aragon-GoBio and other officials and partners from both companies.

Located within the Clark Freeport Zone, in coordination with the Base Conversion Development Authority (BCDA), Clark Development Corporation, and Clark International Airport operator Luzon International Premiere Airport Development Corp. (LIPAD), the development is planned on a 15-Hectare site and is expected to deliver close to 78,000 square meters of gross floor area. It is targeted for completion by the first quarter of 2028.

For Robinsons Land, the project adds scale to its logistics and industrial expansion through Robinsons Logistix and Industrials, Inc. (RLX), its logistics and industrial facilities arm. The Clark development strengthens RLX’s presence in a location shaped by cargo movement, airport access, and regional distribution links.

This upcoming facility also exemplifies Robinsons Land’s broader direction of expanding investment properties and building more diversified income streams. Through RLX, the company is widening its industrial footprint in a way that supports portfolio diversification and strengthens recurring income over time.

“This partnership with FedEx reflects Robinsons Land’s commitment to developing well-located, future-ready logistics facilities that support the growth requirements of world-class companies,” said Cora Ang Ley, Senior Vice-President of Robinsons Land and General Manager of RLX. “Through RCLX, we are building in Clark with a long-term view of operational efficiency, network expansion, and the growing role of the Philippines in regional trade and logistics.”

Once completed, the facility will give Robinsons Land a large-format, built-to-suit logistics development in Clark, further deepening its presence in one of the country’s most active industrial and transport corridors.
